d:
Yashasvi Jaiswal’s attacking 85 and K.L. Rahul’s unbeaten half-century helped India fight back on Day 2 of the first Test against New Zealand. Their 130-run opening partnership took India to 159 for one at stumps, after New Zealand were bowled out for 368, with Henry Nicholls scoring an unbeaten 175.
Thank you for watching our video!
